evidence: Independent source/spec comparison: source preserves a central operator monitoring multiple users and their goal/intermediate-stage/Agent/result links; spec leaves that product purpose to NEXT_SESSION.md and prohibits new product implementation or a personal-review pivot. Current change unit is both handoff packages plus bilingual Harness Kit guidance. Guard requirement is implemented through authoritative source quotes, independent semantic source/spec review, fresh source/spec digests, complete task-to-requirement coverage and original-purpose acceptance; spec explicitly limits machine proof to presence/freshness/coverage and does not claim semantic or cryptographic independence. Publish requirement is an existing-site update and authorized Vercel deployment by the parent after staging, backup and verification, with no new infrastructure, config/hooks, DB/API or log-data changes. Handoff requirement explicitly preserves central multi-user identity/collection/dashboard continuation and names false-direction artifacts and unverified boundaries. Bootstrap tasks cover staged core and Kit work, while spec assigns install, deployment, public artifact checks and NEXT_SESSION.md to the parent; staging phase success alone is insufficient for completion.
